name: Misfortunes
overview: Scripture reveals that despite misfortunes, God's love remains steadfast, demonstrated supremely in the giving of His Son so that believers may have eternal life. Believers can trust that all things, including hardships, work together for their good as they love God and fulfill His purpose. The unfolding of future events, as revealed by Jesus Christ to His servants, assures us that God's sovereign plan encompasses every circumstance, offering hope amid trials.
